encounter: E0010 TRAINER_GRUNT_PETALBURG_WOODS; playtest block P1, cap 14, attempt 1
availability_audit: Every member is drawn from work/reference-pools/pool-14.json with gate<=14, the legality rule this playtest brief uses for the cap-14 window. Roots are recorded per member. Caveat carried in each receipt: some cap-14 roots (VerdanturfMeadow, RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, Route115/116, AlteringCave) sit later in campaign chronology than the Route 102/103/104 fights in this block, so this is a cap-window-legal party, not a party a player literally holds at Petalburg Woods. Held items are ordinary free preparation-catalogue items, one of each, no duplicates.
plan: Magearna leads because Steel is outright immune to Grimer's Poison Jab and Poison Touch, and Steel/Fairy halves Poochyena's Foul Play and Snarl - two of the four members are neutralised by typing alone. Iron Leaves supplies the Grass pressure the dossier names as the crack on both Waters (2x on Carvanha and Wailmer) and Psyblade is 2x on Grimer. Magearna's Thunderbolt is the second Electric tool the counterplay list asks for and is 2x on both Waters, which is how Wailmer gets damaged before Water Spout resolves at full HP.

powder-immune physical breaker; Grass/Psychic resists Water, Electric, Ground, Grass and Fighting, which covers most of this block
Intimidate pivot, Fire/Bug/Grass/Steel breaker, Extreme Speed revenge priority
